subject: Renewal evidence request — BrightWave billing & commit verification
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emily Ng <emily.ng@brightwave.com>, Procurement <procurement@brightwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal evidence request — BrightWave billing & commit verification

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Finance surfaced a mismatch between the committed ARR we have on record and the PO your procurement team uploaded. Before we can finalize the renewal probability and clear the Q3 commit for forecasting, can you please share the following:

- A copy of the signed PO/Amendment that includes the updated ARR line (PDF).
- The latest signed SOW that references any usage-based add-ons (DOCX/PDF).
- A short export of May usage (CSV) showing token counts by service (so we can reconcile billing vs usage).

If procurement prefers, they can send the PO directly to naomi.feldman@redwood.com for finance intake. Goal is to confirm BrightWave will be a firm commit in our forecast by EOD Thursday — that impacts our reserved capacity planning.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if easier.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments referenced: none in this message.

Jordan,

Thanks — apologies for the confusion. Procurement uploaded a draft PO last week but the countersigned version didn't land in the portal. I'm attaching the signed PO and SOW here. Usage export is attached as well; I asked our billing team to include token-level rows, but it's a raw extract.

We will also email Naomi directly so finance has the official copy. Let me know if the PO S/N and total ARR lines are clear or if you need a redlined copy.

Best,

Date: 2027-05-18T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request — BrightWave billing & commit verification

Jordan / Marissa,

I received the PO and SOW from Emily directly — thanks for the quick turnaround. I pulled the numbers and here's what we need clarified before tagging this as a committed ARR in the finance forecast:

1) PO shows total ARR = $420,000 but the Billing contact indicated prorated add-on credits that are not reflected in the PO. Need a short note from BrightWave confirming net annualized value post-credits.
2) Usage export shows May usage spiking for the evaluation project (tokens labeled as sandbox). We need to confirm which usage rows are billable production vs sandbox/test so we can align projected ARR for renewal modeling.
3) Please confirm the effective date on the PO and whether the billing cadence is monthly or annual prepay (this changes recognition).

If BrightWave can supply a two-line confirmation (net ARR after credits + billing cadence), we can move this from "commit-in-review" to "commit" in the forecast and remove the churn-risk flag.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Quick update — procurement confirmed net ARR after the onboarding credit is $408,000 and billing cadence is annual prepay (effective 2027-06-01). They sent a one-paragraph confirmation to Naomi (copied below). We also received a cleaned usage CSV where sandbox rows are marked; finance validated the production-only totals.

"BrightWave confirms net annualized value of $408,000 after application of the onboarding credit. Billing will be annual prepay starting June 1, 2027." — Procurement (procurement@brightwave.com)

Action items / next steps:
- Naomi, please update forecast to mark RDW-3572 as a firm commit for Q3 and remove churn-risk flag.
- Marissa, I'll schedule a short internal handoff with CS to ensure go-forward success plan is in place.
- Emily / procurement: thanks — please keep the PO and confirmation email on file for audit; we'll reference the DocuSign link.

I'll mark this thread closed for forecasting. If anything else pops up, please reopen.

Thanks all,
Jordan
